artifacts.summary: 5-phase, ~3.25h plan wiring verify-lean-mcp.sh into lean skill Stage 2 preflight via a new WARN-only lean-owned wrapper, with a fixture-based regression suite, measured cost, and doc/deploy gates.

memory_candidates.content: When a shell script under agent-system/extensions/ reads a user-global config via a bare "$HOME/..." path with no env override (e.g. core/scripts/verify-lean-mcp.sh reading "$HOME/.claude.json"), a regression suite can still fixture it fully by pointing HOME at a per-fixture mktemp -d dir -- no production-script change, no CONFIG_PATH override parameter, and no reads against the operator's real config. Pair it with an anti-vacuous guard asserting two different failure fixtures produce DIFFERENT messages, which proves the wrapper reads the underlying exit code rather than emitting one blanket message.
